newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ICTSI says Karachi unit to get $45 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: ICTSI says Karachi unit to get $45 mln loan.

text.p: The Karachi Container Terminal Ltd, a subsidiary of International Container Terminal Services Inc (ICTSI) of the Philippines, was raising $45 million to partly finance the building of a container terminal in Karachi, ICTSI said on Wednesday.
"Financing documentation is being completed to pave the way for the financial closing set on 1 December 1996 at the latest," ICTSI said in a statement.
Karachi Container Terminal Ltd is partly owned by the American President Line of the United States.
An ICTSI official said the funding will come from Pakistani financial institutions, which he declined to identify.
The modern container terminal, which approximately cost $73 million to build, will service the traffic of berths 22, 23, 24 and 24A of the Port of Karachi.
The rest of the project cost will be financed through equity contribution. The terminal is expected to start operating before 1998. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
